Contractor FAQ

        
Procurement & delivery questions.

      

      

        
Answers to common tender, billing and logistics questions for projects across Kigali and all provinces of Rwanda.

      

    

    

      
      

        01Can I combine multiple product families into a single quotation?
        
Yes. Use our multi-item quote builder on the Request a Quote page to select several product families (for example, deformed rebar, binding wire, gabion baskets and Sika waterproofing) and list individual line items in a single proforma request.

      

      

        02Do you deliver outside Kigali to other districts in Rwanda?
        
Yes. Customers can collect directly from our yard on KG 667 Street in Kimironko, Kigali, or arrange site delivery across Kigali and provincial districts (including Bugesera, Musanze, Rubavu, Huye, Rwamagana and Rusizi) based on order volume and schedule.

      

      

        03How do I share a full Bill of Quantities (BoQ) or bar bending schedule?
        
You can paste your schedule items into the quote builder, add individual line items, or click the WhatsApp button (+250 793 086 644) or email link (fortimeshrwanda@gmail.com) to attach PDF, Excel or CAD files directly.

      

      

        04Do you provide formal Proforma Invoices for company and institutional procurement?
        
Yes. Include your company or institution name and contact details in your quote request, and our Kigali sales desk will prepare an itemised quotation / proforma invoice confirming unit prices, grades and current stock availability.
